type: post-hoc root-cause analysis (diagnostic only; not part of the acceptance criterion; the app was not changed)
images: 30 test images: the first 20 images where app and notebook disagree + 10 random images where they agree
method: the app's model and metadata encoding, only the image resize to 384 x 384 swapped in a separate diagnostic process; raw (uncorrected) probabilities compared with probs_raw in test_predictions.npz
conclusion: The training notebook resized images with cv2 INTER_LINEAR; the app resizes with cv2 INTER_AREA. With INTER_LINEAR the app reproduces the notebook's probabilities (max difference 0.005 on all 30 images). The weights, metadata encoding and prior correction are identical (80% of all 2,014 images already differ by less than 0.01). On the 62 images with a different class the app was correct 35 times and the notebook 18 times; overall accuracy on the full test set: app 86.64%, notebook 85.80%.
